description: Xray-core (Project X): proxy platform with VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, WireGuard, XTLS Vision and REALITY, routing by geoip/geosite rules; the core that 3X-UI and most V2Ray-style clients run.
notes: Command: xray. Scoop Apps: 'Xray-core' lists the commands and waits for a key.
'xray run' without -c reads config.json from the current folder, otherwise from the app folder:
%USERPROFILE%\scoop\apps\Xray-core\current\config.json, kept across updates (persist). It starts as '{}'.
geoip.dat and geosite.dat here are the small sets that come with Xray (XTLS/Xray-rules-dat).
For other sets set XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET to a folder with both files, e.g. gesu/Loyalsoldier-v2ray-rules-dat:
TUN inbounds need wintun.dll (included for 64-bit and ARM64) and an elevated shell.
pre_install: # main/xray adds the same command 'xray': only one of the two may be installed.

if ($cmd -eq 'install' -and (installed 'xray')) { error "$app conflicts with xray (Scoop's main bucket), which is installed. Run 'scoop uninstall xray' first (its config.json stays in %USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\xray unless you add -p). Scoop has already put $app into its app folder: run 'scoop uninstall $app' or simply install again, which cleans that up."; break }
# 'xray run' falls back to the config.json next to xray.exe; Scoop would make a folder of a missing persisted file.
# The 'Xray-core' shortcut opens this micro-launcher: xray.exe without arguments would try to run config.json.
':: Xray-core: shows what the xray command does and lists its commands, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO Xray-core (Project X): proxy core with VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, WireGuard,',
'ECHO XTLS Vision and REALITY. Run it from any console as xray.',
'ECHO   xray run -c config.json     starts Xray with that config; Ctrl+C stops it',
'ECHO   xray run                    config.json from the current folder, else from:',
'ECHO   xray x25519                 new REALITY key pair',
'ECHO   xray tls ping example.com   checks a site as a REALITY target',
'ECHO unless XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET points to another folder.',
